propositions: 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py use _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run(repo, 'list') pattern that silently fails under CI load, causing test setup to die with misleading AssertionError
8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions where the sync MUST land for the test to be meaningful; a failed sync silently produces absent or misleading test failure
15 of the 23 sites deliberately exercise the production read-side sync path as the behavior under test itself, so replacing with deterministic git would delete the invariant being proved
_sync_from_origin helper (checked fetch + ff-only merge) correctly replaces the 8 precondition sites, with downstream asserts marked SETUP to distinguish harness failures from invariant failures
_reconverge_by_read_sync named helper encapsulates the 15 read-side sync sites, documenting why best-effort behavior is deliberate there
All test conversions pass under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off (the reproduction switch proving the original flake) and under default environment
